shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git show --stat HEAD | head -30; node --version; head -c 600 package-lock.json
npm pkg set scripts.start="node server.js" scripts.test="vitest run" && printf 'data/\n' >> .gitignore && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -30

DATA_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3999 node server.js & sleep 1
B=http://127.0.0.1:3999
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "add: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -H "Origin: $B" -H "Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin" --data-urlencode "title=The Hobbit" --data-urlencode "author=J.R.R. Tolkien" --data-urlencode "notes=Re-read" $B/books
ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/tmp/smoke/books.json')).at(0).id)")
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "book page: %{http_code}\n" $B/books/$ID
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "finish: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -H "Origin: $B" -d "return=book" $B/books/$ID/finish
curl -sI $B/ | head -3
curl -s $B/books/$ID | sed -n '/<article>/,/<\/article>/p'
cat /tmp/smoke/books.json
kill %1; rm -rf /tmp/smoke
